name: ElkhornBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of an elkhorn coral structure. The object reveals the raw geometric form of elkhorn coral — multiple wide, flat, blade-like branches fanning outward from a central root, with ragged and irregular edges along each branch. Without any texture or material applied, the pure white mesh clearly shows the broad planar topology of the branching structure, with thin, layered panels extending in a low, sweeping arc. A diffuse shadow beneath emphasizes the complex silhouette.
